Blackhawk Monday Evening Ride

Cherry Valley, IL · Road

Beginner friendly

Blackhawk Monday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Cherry Valley, IL. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from City parking lot across from Baumann Park. About 12–28 miles, leisure (10–13 mph); a fast group may go separately.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Blackhawk Monday Evening Ride group ride

A Rockford-area club ride from Cherry Valley on flat to rolling roads. Groups sort out their own speed, route and distance, from 12 to 28 miles. The same lot hosts a Wednesday 5:30 pm ride. Check the club's event calendar to see which rides are active.
